sentences.en: At the end of the speech she repeated the word.
sentences.zh: 演讲结束时她重复了那个单词。

sentences.en: The die is cast. I repeat: The die is cast.
sentences.zh: 决心已定。我再重申一遍：决心已定。

sentences.en: Under no circumstances should you repeat this to anyone.
sentences.zh: 无论如何你都不能把这个告诉任何人。

senses.zh: 重复；复述；背诵(节目)重演，重播
